cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll go through my birthday honestly. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, we'll use the photo. He came for dessert; by dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

reason: A accepts B photograph as the evidence for the explanation while retaining control of progressively smaller definitions; preserve the core meal continuity and remove boilerplate.
